paper: J. M. Dudley, G. Genty, S. Coen, Supercontinuum generation in photonic crystal fiber, Rev. Mod. Phys. 78, 1135 (2006)
description: Shared model for the femtosecond anomalous-GVD supercontinuum scenario of Dudley et al. (2006), Sec. V-VI. 15 cm of highly nonlinear PCF (d=1.4 um, Lambda=1.6 um, ZDW ~780 nm) pumped at 835 nm. Table I Taylor coefficients at 835 nm; sech input; fR=0.18; tau_shock=0.56 fs.

fig05_ideal_soliton.note: Ideal higher-order N=3 soliton, NLSE only: beta2 alone, fR=0, shock off. Fig. 5.

fig06_raman_fission.note: Raman-induced fission of an N=3 soliton: beta2 + Raman, shock off. Figs. 6-7.

fig08_dispersive_wave.note: The j=1 ejected fundamental soliton of Figs. 6-7: P0=3.48 kW, T0=5.67 fs, full PCF dispersion. Fig. 8.

fig09_dw_energy.note: Raman influence on the dispersive wave: mean soliton frequency and DW energy fraction vs z. Fig. 9.

fig03_basic_scg.note: Full SCG: Table I betas, Raman, self-steepening. Fig. 3.

fig23_mi_gain.note: CW parametric (MI) gain versus pump wavelength for the same PCF, CW power 500 W. Fig. 23.
